input: Inflect v2 is a parameter-efficient VITS-family end-to-end text-to-waveform generator with an English phoneme frontend, monotonic alignment, stochastic latent synthesis, residual coupling flow, and an integrated alias-reduced neural waveform decoder.

ground_truth.requirement: States that Inflect v2 belongs to the VITS family.
Explains that the model is parameter-efficient, meaning it is designed to provide its functionality using a relatively small number of model parameters.
Explains that the model is end-to-end, meaning the process from text input to generated audio is handled as one integrated model pipeline.
Explains that the model generates a waveform from text, i.e. converts written text into an audio signal.
Mentions that the model has an English phoneme frontend.
Explains that phonemes are the basic sound units used to represent spoken language.
Explains that the phoneme frontend processes English text into phoneme information used by the model.
Mentions monotonic alignment.
Explains that monotonic alignment establishes the correspondence between the sequence of text/phonemes and the sequence of generated audio over time while preserving their order.
Mentions stochastic latent synthesis.
Explains that stochastic latent synthesis involves generating the speech using latent variables with an element of randomness or variation.
Mentions residual coupling flow.
Explains that residual coupling flow is a flow-based transformation used within the model to transform or refine its internal representation for speech generation.
Mentions the integrated alias-reduced neural waveform decoder.
Explains that the neural waveform decoder converts the model's internal representation into the final audio waveform.
Explains that alias reduction reduces unwanted artifacts or distortions that can occur when generating the audio waveform.
Does not introduce unsupported claims about the model's capabilities, training, quality, or benefits.

input: Step 3.7 Flash is a 198B-parameter sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) vision-language model that combines a 196B-parameter language backbone with a 1.8B-parameter vision encoder for native image understanding.

ground_truth.requirement: States that Step 3.7 Flash is a vision-language model, meaning it can work with both visual and language information.
States that the model has approximately 198 billion parameters.

States that the model uses a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture.
Explains that a Mixture-of-Experts architecture consists of multiple specialized components or 'experts' and that only a subset of them is used for a particular input.
States that the model contains a 196-billion-parameter language backbone.
Explains that the language backbone is the main part of the model responsible for processing language information.
States that the model contains a 1.8-billion-parameter vision encoder.
Explains that a vision encoder processes information from images and converts it into a form the model can use.
Explains that the language backbone and vision encoder are combined as parts of the same model.

States that the model provides native image understanding, meaning image information can be processed directly as part of the model rather than requiring a separate external image-understanding system.
